items.title: The New York Times cut Oracle migration time from 18 to 5 months
items.summary: Learn how The New York Times migrated its PLATO subscription revenue engine from Oracle to Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL in about 5 months instead of 18, using an AI-agent-native approach on Amazon Bedrock with AWS DMS to automate schema conversion and multi-language code remediation at enterprise scale.
items.creator: Eli DOE

items.title: How Vestiaire Collective achieved near-zero downtime RDS for MariaDB upgrades with Amazon RDS Blue/Green Deployments
items.summary: Vestiaire Collective, a global platform for pre-owned luxury fashion, achieved near-zero downtime upgrading its Amazon RDS for MariaDB fleet across two major versions. Learn how the team used Amazon RDS Blue/Green Deployments with AWS Countdown Premium to deliver a 94-second and then a 7-second switchover during peak sales season.
items.creator: Ejaz Azeem
